notes.title: Dream Mirror, finally live on Oculus Store!
notes.notes:
Hello, we want to share this awesome news with everyone, we are very exited to announce that our game after a long process and a very long waiting finally got approved on Oculus store.


No link will be posted, you can view the game by searching there.

[previewyoutube=xmzalHPmZBA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Milestone Reached
notes.notes:
Hello, 

We want first to thank you so much for your feedback!

We made the game to work on all compatible VR Headsets such as the Oculus Quest 2, Rift-S, HTC Vive, Valve Index, Windows Mixed Reality (WMR), and Pico Headsets.

In addition, to this, as requested, we added a truly horror map (physiological horror).

And last but not least, Dream Mirror has been finally approved on Oculus Store and will be available on 12-14 August 2021 and yes, we will look into merging keys on both stores.


Thank you all for supporting our work and we hope we will make a horror game soon, with your help that is!

In-game footage:
[previewyoutube=xmzalHPmZBA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dream Mirror - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, dear reader,[/h1]

I am the developer of Dream Mirror, the game is inspired from Oculus Dreamdeck (my first VR experience) and Stargate SG1 (huge fan). I developed this game in the hope it can deliver a more complete VR experience then Dreamdeck, a VR experience where you can actually interact with the environment fully or partial (depends on map), a place you can revisit after a hard day and listen to the environment sounds or use the built in music player to listen to your own songs.

Without further adieu we invite you to read the Dream Mirror Mythology and to watch and read the game story, you're story!

[h2]Dream Mirror - Mythology[/h2]
In an ancient temple fill with unseen treasures, I found a tablet that had a carved text:
"Those who places the stone on the pedestal will invoke a magic mirror, in the mirror you will see a different world, step into the mirror to instantly travel to that world and if is too much for you use the ancient wristband to travel back to the forgotten temple of RA."

[previewyoutube=eTrM8fPbhoE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Player Story[/h2]
When I first stepped into my new home I felt it had something mysterious.
Then discovering the rooms, I came across a bracelet that had a strange green stone, I put it on my hand and it felt like it was mine forever.
Suddenly, the stone began to shine very brightly, curious about my new finding, I touched it and a chill came over me after which I saw nothing and I woke up in a treasure room,
 where I found a papyrus with inscriptions about a shining stone and a pedestal, I immediately understood that I had to put the stone on the pedestal. Suddenly the room began to shake, the inscriptions shining a brilliant light through out the room and a pillar
 with a mirror in the middle appeared as if it were a window to another world ...

[h2]Game Description[/h2]
Dream Mirror transports you to Immersive environments and magical worlds where you can Interact with environment and solve puzzles to pass the level. 

[h2]Plans[/h2]
In the future we plan on adding more worlds to explore and make the maps even more intractable.
